ValidationRule.description: To make agents phone or email mandatory when escalating to QIC or sale support.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( RecordType.Name=="Service Request", OR( ISPICKVAL( Escalate_To__c , 'QAC AU Escalation Queue') , ISPICKVAL( Escalate_To__c , 'AU Sales Support Queue')), LEN(Consultant_Phone__c & Consultant_Email__c )<1 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the agent's phone number OR email address to escalate this case.
